_comment: Docs-side overrides for the Visual Embed SDK reference generated by scripts/converter/index.ts. The SDK source comments stay the source of truth; an entry here only applies when the SDK has no value of its own (descriptions) or when the docs need a different sidebar grouping (groups).

descriptions.executeTMLInput: Input for the `executeTML` function. Specifies the TML objects to import, the import policy, and whether to create new objects.
descriptions.exportTMLInput: Input for the `exportTML` function. Specifies the objects to export and the format and options for the exported TML.
descriptions.SessionInterface: Identifies an Answer session on the ThoughtSpot server. Used by `AnswerService` and returned in the `session` property of Answer-related payloads.
descriptions.UnderlyingDataPoint: A data point (a column ID and its value) used to fetch the underlying data of a selected point in a chart or table. Passed to `AnswerService.getUnderlyingDataForPoint`.
descriptions.PrefetchFeatures: The embed features whose static resources can be prefetched. Pass these values in the `prefetchFeatures` parameter of the `prefetch` function.
descriptions.DOMSelector: A CSS selector string or an HTMLElement that identifies the DOM node in which to render an embedded component. Used by the constructors of the embed components, such as `AppEmbed`, `LiveboardEmbed`, and `SearchEmbed`.
descriptions.HomePageSearchBarMode: Modes for the search bar on the home page of an embedded ThoughtSpot application. Set this value in the `homePageSearchBarMode` property of `AppViewConfig`.
descriptions.VizPoint: A selected point in a visualization, described by its selected attributes and measures. Used by `AnswerService` and in the context menu payload of a custom action.
descriptions.UIPassthroughEvent: Identifiers of the UI passthrough requests. Each value maps to a request and response pair, as described in `UIPassthroughContractBase`.

landingPage.description: Reference for the classes, interfaces, enumerations, types, and functions of the Visual Embed SDK.
intro: The Visual Embed SDK reference describes the classes, interfaces, enumerations, types, and functions of the `@thoughtspot/visual-embed-sdk` package. It is generated from the comments in the SDK source code.
Browse the categories on this page, or use the navigation menu on the left. For an overview of how to embed ThoughtSpot with the SDK, see xref:getting-started.adoc[Embed with Visual Embed SDK].

groupDescriptions.Authentication / Init: Initialize the SDK and authenticate users. Call `init` with an `EmbedConfig` object before you embed any ThoughtSpot component. This category also includes the enumerations for the authentication type, status, and log level, and the event emitter that `init` returns.
groupDescriptions.Full application embed: Embed the full ThoughtSpot application with `AppEmbed` and configure it with `AppViewConfig`. This category also includes the enumerations for the options of the full application: the pages to show, the versions of the home page, list page, and primary navigation bar, and the home page modules, left navigation items, and search bar modes.
groupDescriptions.Liveboard embed: Embed a Liveboard with `LiveboardEmbed` and configure it with `LiveboardViewConfig`. This category also includes the interfaces for the filters, Parameters, and data source overrides that you apply when a Liveboard loads.
groupDescriptions.Search embed: Embed the ThoughtSpot Search page with `SearchEmbed`, or only the search bar with `SearchBarEmbed`, and configure them with `SearchViewConfig` and `SearchBarViewConfig`. This category also includes the options for the data source panel and the data panel on the Search page.
groupDescriptions.Spotter embed: Classes and configuration types for embedding Spotter, the ThoughtSpot AI analytics experience. Use `SpotterEmbed` for the Spotter interface and `SpotterAgentEmbed` for chatbots and other conversational interfaces. This category also includes the interfaces for customizing the chat, the sidebar, conversation sharing, and starter prompts.
groupDescriptions.Shared embed options: Types that all embed components use: the iframe settings (`FrameParams`), the element in which a component renders (`DOMSelector`), and the groups of ThoughtSpot APIs that you can intercept (`InterceptedApiType`).
groupDescriptions.Events: Events and callbacks for communication between your app and an embedded component. Use `EmbedEvent` to listen to the events that the embedded application emits, `HostEvent` to trigger actions in the embedded application, and `AnswerService` to work with Answers. This category also includes the types that these events and `AnswerService` use.
groupDescriptions.Host event payloads: Types for the data that you send to, or receive from, the embedded application: the payloads that `trigger` accepts for host events, and the request and response shapes of UI passthrough events. This category also includes the Liveboard filter, parameter, group, and tab types that these payloads use.
groupDescriptions.Actions: Action IDs and custom action types. Use the `Action` IDs to show, hide, or disable the menu actions of an embedded component, and `CustomAction` to add your own code-based actions. On the `Action` page, you can filter the actions by embed type.
groupDescriptions.Visual Overrides: Enumerations and an interface for customizing how charts and tables render in embedded visualizations, such as conditional formatting, data labels, legend position, and table theme and density.
groupDescriptions.Custom styles: Interfaces for customizing the look and feel of embedded ThoughtSpot content, such as CSS variables and custom CSS rules. Set them in the `customizations` property of `EmbedConfig`.
groupDescriptions.Runtime filters: Filters and parameters that you apply to embedded content when it loads: the `RuntimeFilter` and `RuntimeParameter` interfaces, the `RuntimeFilterOp` operators that you use in runtime filters, and the types that set the level at which a filter or parameter applies.
groupDescriptions.Error Handling: Error codes, severity levels, and event types for handling the errors that embedded components emit.
groupDescriptions.Global methods: Functions that you call directly, without an embed component: log out, prefetch static resources, reload the embedded frame, call ThoughtSpot APIs with an authenticated request (`tokenizedFetch`), get session and initialization information, import and export TML (`executeTML` and `exportTML`), create a Liveboard from Answers (`createLiveboardWithAnswers`), get an Answer from a natural language query (`getAnswerFromQuery`), convert a captured filter state (`convertFilterChangedToUpdateFiltersPayload`), and automatically render the ThoughtSpot MCP app frames on a page (`startAutoMCPFrameRenderer`). This category also includes the types that these functions use.
groupDescriptions.Others: Additional enumerations, interfaces, and types that the SDK uses and that do not belong to another category, such as the log level, the levels at which a filter applies, and the groups of APIs that you can intercept.

typeDescriptions.Enumerations: Enumerations define fixed sets of values that you use to configure the SDK or to identify an event, an action, or an error. For example, `AuthType` sets the authentication method, `HostEvent` and `EmbedEvent` name the events that you trigger and listen to, and `Action` lists the action IDs of the embedded ThoughtSpot UI.
typeDescriptions.Classes: Classes are the building blocks that you create in your app. The embed classes, such as `AppEmbed`, `LiveboardEmbed`, `SearchEmbed`, and `SpotterEmbed`, render ThoughtSpot content in your page. `AnswerService` works with the data of an Answer.
typeDescriptions.Interfaces: Interfaces describe the shape of the objects that you pass to, or receive from, the SDK: the configuration that you pass to `init` (`EmbedConfig`), the view configuration of each embed component, and the payloads of events and callbacks.
typeDescriptions.Type aliases: Type aliases name the union and helper types that the SDK uses, such as the types of event payloads, callbacks, and the selector that identifies the element in which to render an embedded component.
typeDescriptions.Functions: Functions that you call directly, without an embed component: `init` to initialize the SDK and authenticate users, `logout`, `prefetch`, `executeTML` and `exportTML` to import and export TML, and other utilities.

actionEmbedTypes._confirmed_help: For an Action that is not in the table on the page above yet: once a writer has confirmed its embed types, add "ActionName": ["LiveboardEmbed", "AppEmbed"] to this list. It gets a 'Supported in' line and shows under those embed types in the filter. The table wins if an Action is in both, so remove the entry here once the row is on the page.

commentFixes.reason: The SDK comment lists three bullets, but the second and third are wrapped into the middle of a line, so they show as one run-on paragraph. Remove this entry once the comment in the SDK source is fixed (the converter says when the match no longer applies).
commentFixes.find: To control actions in the embedded view: - disabledActions — the action is grayed out and still visible, but non-interactive (user can see but not click). - hiddenActions — the action is completely removed from the UI (user cannot see it at all). - visibleActions — allowlist, only these actions are shown; all others are hidden.
commentFixes.replace:
To control actions in the embedded view:

* disabledActions — the action is grayed out and still visible, but non-interactive (user can see but not click).
* hiddenActions — the action is completely removed from the UI (user cannot see it at all).
* visibleActions — allowlist, only these actions are shown; all others are hidden.
